verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document the story's capabilities: custom pipeline stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, or bulk actions across a pipeline. The only related items are a generic marketing claim of "Custom, flexible configurations" that does not mention stages, and Automation Hub's automatic advancing of candidates. Automated rules are an adjacent feature, not recruiter-driven bulk actions or drag-and-drop stage moves, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As a recruiter, I run configurable hiring pipelines — custom stages per job, drag-to-move candidates, and bulk actions across the whole pipeline
